name: PD-137889
summary: PD-137889 (N-methylhexahydrofluorenamine) is a chemical compound that is active as an NMDA receptor antagonist in the central nervous system at roughly 30 times the potency of the "flagship" of its class, ketamine, and substitutes for phencyclidine in animal studies. Ki [3H]TCP binding = 27 nM versus ketamine's Ki = 860 nM.

pharmacology.text: PD-137889 (N-methylhexahydrofluorenamine) is a chemical compound that is active as an NMDA receptor antagonist in the central nervous system at roughly 30 times the potency of the "flagship" of its class, ketamine, and substitutes for phencyclidine in animal studies. Ki [3H]TCP binding = 27 nM versus ketamine's Ki = 860 nM.

summaryZh: PD-137889（N-甲基六氫芴胺）是一種化學化合物，中樞神經系統NMDA受體拮抗劑，效力比氯胺酮強約30倍，動物研究中可替代五氯苯酚。Ki[3H]TCP = 27 nM，氯胺酮Ki = 860 nM。

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study the NMDA receptor. It is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於探討 NMDA 受體，並非藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于探讨 NMDA 受体，并非药物。

fact.en: The PD codes come from Parke-Davis, the Detroit company that also made PCP and ketamine, and this compound blocks the same NMDA receptor channel.
fact.zh: 「PD」編號來自底特律的派德藥廠，該公司也製造了 PCP 與氯胺酮，而這個化合物阻斷的正是同一個 NMDA 受體通道。
fact.zhHans: 「PD」编号来自底特律的派德药厂，该公司也制造了 PCP 与氯胺酮，而这个化合物阻断的正是同一个 NMDA 受体信道。
